title: Verify and extend dealsStore with CRUD and status management
description: Review existing dealsStore.ts and extend with any missing CRUD operations and status management functions

steps.title: Review existing dealsStore implementation
steps.description: Review src/stores/dealsStore.ts to understand current implementation

steps.title: Verify Zod schemas for Deal, DealStatus, Deliverable, PaymentInfo

steps.title: Add missing CRUD operations if needed
steps.description: Add getDealById function if missing, verify updateDeal handles nested updates for deliverables and payments

acceptanceCriteria: dealsStore has all required CRUD operations (add, update, delete, get)

Store persists data via zustand/middleware persist
